rows.abstract: "The Cellular Phone Anti-Cloning Act"  Defines the term "cloning" as a technical process of tampering or manipulating any part or device of any cellular phone unit by using or employing any electronic devices, computers, its combination or other equipment of similar nature in order to access and program the Electronic Serial Number (ESN) and the Mobile Serial NUmber (MSN), the unique identification numbers electronically programmed into a microchip of the cellular phone units, of a duly registered cellular phone unit into another cellular phone unit, without the authorization or approval of a cellular phone service provider.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ACCORDING EQUAL RIGHTS TO WIVES AND HUSBANDS IN THE PHILIPPINES BY AMENDING ARTICLES 333, 334 AND 344 OF ACT NUMBERED THREE THOUSAND EIGHT HUNDRED AND FIFTEEN, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Changes the terms "adultery" and "concubinage" in the Revised Penal Code with the new term "SEXUAL INFIDELITY" with the end in view of correcting the seemingly unfair treatment insofar as the imposition of penalty to the wife who is penalized with aheavier penalty for a single act of infidelity in contrast to the marital indiscretions of the husband which is not treated as a felony unless attended by qualifying circumstances.

rows.abstract: Declares it a State policy to promote functional computer literacy in all schools, at the earliest possible stage, and in a manner that is most efficient and effective in producing a population that is highly skilled in the creation, use and manipulation of computer softrware.
